channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: AI-generated text will also come with built-in "authentication tags": SpaceXAI announces it will add invisible watermarks to all Grok models starting November 7
item.description: SpaceXAI will add invisible watermarks embedded in the token-selection process to text from all Grok models starting November 7, already enabled across its global API, with enterprise administrators able to disable them for specific models. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic updates Claude restrictions on recreating existing video games
item.description: Anthropic's Claude update adds code restrictions that block remaking existing commercial video games, allowing only original work or user-owned assets, a move engineer Addy Osmani confirms is meant to avoid copyright infringement risk. (AIbase)

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources Super-agent architecture, drawing on classic computer system design to break the single-session agent bottleneck
item.description: DeepSeek Harness on October 31 open-sourced Super-agent, an agent architecture borrowing classic systems ideas—scheduling, caching, compute-storage separation—with a Router layer and concurrent Worker layer to break single-session bottlenecks. (AIbase)

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude 5.5 Flagships Leaked on the Same Day, Sending Silicon Valley Into a Frenzy
item.description: OpenAI skipped GPT-6.1 and, after a month of retraining following safety-test problems, moved GPT-6.2 Astra into Codex backend gray rollout at nearly 20% traffic, while Anthropic's website source code leaked Claude 5.5. (AIbase)

item.title: Meta teams up with Fourier to unveil humanoid robot prototype Max in just three months
item.description: Meta and Fourier Intelligence built the roughly 1.5-meter-tall, 48-kilogram humanoid robot prototype Max in just three months, equipping it with Nvidia's Jetson Thor chip and starting work on Max2. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI's big PR push: rebranding "data centers" as "AI compute parks
item.description: OpenAI plans a large-scale public relations campaign after Tuesday’s U.S. midterm elections, led by Chris Lehane, who calls the midterms a “trailer” for 2028 and pushes renaming “data centers” as “AI compute parks. (AIbase)

item.title: Usage for Claude + ChatGPT 4.0 — Claude + ChatGPT limits on your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch
item.description: A "Performing security verification" CAPTCHA page is all that loads in place of the promised breakdown of Claude and ChatGPT 4.0 usage limits across Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch. (Product Hunt)

item.title: OpenAI plans to rebrand its data centers as "AI compute campuses" to ease public pressure
item.description: OpenAI plans to rebrand data centers as "AI compute campuses" after the midterms, with global affairs chief Chris Lehane saying AI could become a 2028 election issue and floating "speed limits" to ease electricity disputes. (AIbase)

item.title: Apollo economist says AI has "no economic payoff" for most businesses
item.description: Apollo economist argues that despite massive AI investment and widespread hype, corporate America outside the tech sector has seen zero financial payoff, highlighting the gap between AI spending and returns. (techcrunch.com)

item.title: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub — In-depth tutorials on LLMs, RAGs and real-world AI agent applications.
item.description: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub gathers in-depth LLM, RAG and real-world AI agent tutorials tiered from beginner to researcher, spanning single- and multi-component agentic workflows, fine-tuning and production deployment, plus a free 150+ lesson Data Science eBook. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: telemetry.dev — Observability for AI agents
item.description: The telemetry.dev page titled "Observability for AI agents" returns only a "Performing security verification" CAPTCHA prompt, so readers get no actual information on AI agent observability. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Cisco gave a 27-year-old engineer "unlimited Tokens" to rewrite 98% of its legacy code
item.description: Cisco handed 27-year-old engineer Paddy a nearly unlimited AI compute budget and a 24-month mandate to rewrite 98% of its old code, with no spending cap and no disclosed progress yet. (AIbase)

item.title: It’s not AI that reverses a proton’s charge
item.description: Proton CEO Andy Yen dismissed an engineer's request for a few days of penetration testing before shipping as "loser thinking" and tied AI use to employee retention, raising why security guardrails at a privacy company are treated as a burden. (blog.raed.dev)

item.title: Minecraft's AI agent colony fails to build a civilization, getting mired in bureaucracy instead
item.description: A Minecraft experiment in which AI agents attempted to build a civilization failed, with the agents bogged down in bureaucracy, in a test meant to offer insight into recent AI agent headlines. (www.tomshardware.com)

item.title: The AI Cost of JavaScript Frameworks
item.description: Nolan Lawson benchmarks JavaScript frameworks by having each generate a Pokémon app through MCP with Opus 5.5, then measures Lighthouse performance and accessibility to test agent-friendliness. (nolanlawson.com)

item.title: Saudi Aramco shells out 17.5 billion to pull a national AI champion into its oil empire
item.description: Saudi Aramco is taking a 49% stake in PIF-owned AI firm HUMAIN with about 9.9 billion Saudi riyals in assets, while PIF keeps 51% control and plans AI for seismic exploration, refining scheduling and supply-chain energy optimization. (AIbase)

item.title: Meituan's LongCat releases LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter natively multimodal model
item.description: Meituan LongCat released LongCat-2.5 on November 2, a native multimodal model with 1.6 trillion total parameters that activates roughly 48 billion per token for long-horizon agent tasks, with a demo and API already open. (AIbase)

item.title: Alibaba Qwen AI glasses OTA update adds real-time translation for calls and video
item.description: Alibaba's Qwen AI glasses' November 2 OTA update translates the other party's speech into the wearer's native language during calls and cross-border meetings, and syncs subtitles in the companion app for foreign podcasts, online courses and films. (AIbase)
